This ensures predictable, type-safe results and simplifies extracting structured data from unstructured text. Using structured outputs is ideal for: Data extraction: Pull specific information like names and dates from text. Structured classification: Classify text into predefined categories. Agentic workf

Structured outputs versus function calling Feature Primary Use Case Structured Outputs Formatting the final response. Use when you want the model's answer in a specific format. Function Calling Taking action during conversation. Use when the model needs to ask you to perform a task before providing a final answer.
